caption:
genuine question — does anyone else wear two things that disagree every morning?

#oura #whoop #applewatch

slides.text:
Anyone else wearing
two things that disagree?

The ring says recovered

The watch says strained

Both are measuring
real things

Neither is deciding anything

So you pick the one
that agrees with your mood

Which is not a system

Or you let something
read both and commit

slides.heading: Two devices, one answer
slides.body: SOMA takes Apple Health, Oura and Whoop together and returns a single call for today
